methods.name: candidates
methods.doc: Remote face of {@link listCandidates}: the configured candidate limit applies, and every candidate carries the canonical mention a host inserts into the prompt draft.

props.name: mention
props.doc: Canonical `@[label](dsh-session:…)` mention serialized into the prompt draft.

props.name: label
props.doc: Latest log-backed title, falling back to the opaque session id.

props.name: displayTitle
props.doc: Display and canonical-mention text, preferring a subagent's durable creation label over {@link label}.

props.name: cwd
props.doc: Source session working directory, when recorded.

props.name: sameWorkspace
props.doc: True when {@link SessionReferenceCandidate.cwd} is recorded and equals the requesting agent's. Hosts that only surface a distinguishing location read this instead of comparing paths they never received.

props.name: createdAt
props.doc: Source session creation time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

SessionReferenceMentionCandidate.doc: One discovery candidate carrying its canonical prompt mention.
